card.name: The word liver and 'the' before awards
card.fires_on: The word "liver" (or its parts, like hepatic) right before function, enzymes or tests in lab-monitoring text. Also "the" just before a named military decoration such as Iron Cross.

modes.label: Liver before tests
modes.description: "liver" or "hepatic" starting a phrase about liver function tests or enzymes.
modes.example: Obtain<< liver>> function studies initially and repeat at 2

modes.label: The before medal
modes.description: "the" right before a named military honor in a biography.
modes.example: was decorated with<< the>> Iron Cross Second Class and First Class;

card.plain: It fires on the word liver when liver tests or enzymes come next, and oddly also on "the" before a war medal.
